blocks.text: Breakfast, then a private city tour and Comuna 13 tour (7 hours) with an English-speaking guide: San Antonio Park, San Ignacio Square, Avenida La Playa, the Plaza Botero with more than 20 sculptures donated by Fernando Botero, the Park of Wishes, the Atanasio Girardot Sports Complex, the former La Macarena bullring and the Pueblito Paisa; then El Poblado, with Poblado Park, Parque Lleras and the Golden Mile. Continue to Comuna 13, by Metro and Metrocable, for a graffiti tour of the murals of local artists, telling stories of social transformation and hope, ending at its famous outdoor escalators.

blocks.text: Breakfast, then a private excursion (8 hours) with an English-speaking guide to El Peñol, with its replica of the original colonial town, flooded to create the reservoir, and the majestic Piedra del Peñol, a granite monolith some 220 metres high; then the colourful town of Guatapé, famous for the zócalos, the painted reliefs decorating its house fronts (explored by moto-taxi), and the reservoirs of El Peñol and Guatapé, where green mountains meet mirror-like water. Typical lunch at a local restaurant. The climb up the Piedra del Peñol and the boat trip on the reservoir are not included.
